1204732550:
Gunworks

The Gunworks of Alkenstar was built in 4620 AR⁠ and has been the primary source of firearms in the Grand Duchy and the rest of Golarion ever since.⁠
1224125060:
Mengkare's Lair

Mengkare (pronounced meng-car-ay) is a gold archdragon who ruled the island kingdom of Hermea in the Steaming Sea⁠ until his arrest in 4720 AR by agents of the draconic deity Otilaz to face trial for undisclosed offenses. His fate as of 4725 AR was unknown.⁠
1224731400:
Pagked

Pagked is a small town in decline, that was once full of bustling factories.⁠
1232240140:
Pensaris

Pensaris is a small village nestled on the bank of Lake Pensaris and one of the most prosperous settlements in Meratt county of Taldor, behind only the larger trade town of Lotheedar in terms of wealth. This prosperity is due to the wise stewardship of House Okerra under the leadership of Baron Nicolaus Okerra, who rules from the neighbouring Okerra Estate. Baron Okerra assists this prosperity by sometimes giving no-interest loans to the most enterprising people of Pensaris, but recently this practice has ceased due to the increased taxes levied by Count Lotheed, much to the annoyance of Baron Okerra.⁠
1234618360:
Zhukuo Tegeg

Zhukuo Tegeg is the communal cemetery of the town of Ngozu on the Mgange Cove island of the Shackles. As of 4712 AR, several juju zombies had recently emerged from the eerie cemetery. Chief wendifa Ajuoga Baas put down many of these undead monsters but sought aid from outsiders to end the zombie menace. Some of Ajuoga's followers thus began to doubt her worthiness as chief wendifa.⁠
1243549680:
Hope Lost

The Hope Lost mine in the Irrisen province of Wintercrux produces the rare blue quartz crystals known as ice diamonds that are notoriously arduous to excavate. Many forced to work here by the White Witches or Cold Sisters die quickly due to the mine's brutal conditions.⁠

The vicious Countess Grinnelise, whose palace is carved into the face of the mountain, oversees the mine. Enslaved miners prefer the daily beatings of the ice troll gang bosses over being summoned to the countess' palace, where the screams of victims during her notorious orgies of cannibalism and torture are unbearable.⁠

At some point recent to 4712 AR, some slaves escaped using a secret tunnel and the help of yetis who dwell in a large warren deep in the mountains. The slaves gave stolen ice diamonds to the yetis in thanks.⁠
1252609250:
Greengate

The Greengate is Kintargo's easternmost gate, located in The Greens district. It is the main overland link with the rest of Ravounel, and as such it normally remains closed. The Greengate is mostly used by visiting dignitaries and nobles but sees little actual trade, unlike the busier Nightways Gate to the north.⁠⁠
1263388440:
Wreck of the Brine Demon

1 locations:
  • Scallywag
1271478000:
Elidir

Elidir (pronounced EL-eh-deer)⁠ is both the capital of Isger and the nation's largest city. Far from the Chitterwood, Elidir escaped the worst of the Goblinblood Wars, a fact that still engenders bitterness from those whose homes were overrun. It is a commonly held belief throughout the rest of the country that if the capital had been in greater danger during the war, the fighting would have been over much faster.⁠
1280408510:
Doorway to the Red Star

The Doorway to the Red Star is a ring of mysterious, humming red stones in an empty courtyard surrounded by overgrown cathedrals. It is located north of Lake Ocota in the Mwangi Expanse.⁠
1290292480:
Sepet Pass

Sepet Pass is a high pass in the Brazen Peaks in Osirion on the route between Ipeq and El-Fatar.⁠ At the top of the pass, the Hostel Sepet provides safety for travelers.⁠
1293838180:
Arbor Ward

The Arbor Ward is a neighborhood in the Ivy District that boasts some of the city's finest restaurants, whose culinary recipes are tasted by travelers who will take them back to their nations across the Inner Sea, expanding their influence. From open-air restaurants to establishments with waiting lists exceeding three months, one can find the flavors they're looking for and those yet to be discovered in the district.⁠
1297297000:
Shadeglass Foundry

Shadeglass Foundry is Pangolais's main producer of shadowglass, using its location near the Usk River to facilitate the transport of the wood used in its creation. Art pieces made with this glass are highly prized by collectors and can also be used as materials for shadow-related spells.⁠
1303829300:
Records Hall

Records Hall, located in the aristocratic district of The Greens, once stored all records of Kintargo's nobility. However, in the decades since House Thrune's ascension, the once impeccable records have been altered, redacted, and ravaged, and the collection is a shadow of its former self.⁠⁠
1305909500:
Maroux's Isle

Maroux's Isle is located in the northeastern part of the Lady's Cape, marking the last place one encounters civilization before entering the cape itself. An old trail leads to the island, which is connected by a bridge. Several boggard and xulgath heads have been placed there as warnings to the local tribes not to approach. The island contains only a hut, where the witch Maroux lives, preferring solitude and avoiding interaction with the rest of society.⁠
1326114960:
Undarin

The central city of Undarin in Sarkoris is located on the Sarkora River at its confluence with the dry bed of the Rolling River, and was once a center for the selling of livestock and ore in the kingdom of Sarkoris. Once the city was overrun by demons after the opening of the Worldwound in 4606 AR, its stockyards and animal pens were used to temporarily control the human population before being sent off for further processing.⁠ Like most of the cities in the region, the holy warriors of the Fifth Mendevian Crusade deemed Undarin to be too corrupted to be rebuilt, and instead razed the city in 4718 AR.⁠⁠
1328480550:
Pestico's Dolls and Figurines

Pestico's Dolls and Figurines is a shop located in the south of the Midland district that sells dolls and figurines to the delight of children all across the city of Korvosa. The shop is run by Vadid Pestico: a kindly, but fragile, old man, who builds the store's dolls. His late wife, Kiristi, used to sculpt the figurines, until her death over a decade ago. Recently Vadid unveiled a project he had been working on for a long time: a group of six soulbound dolls he named "Pestico's Daughters". These 'daughters' help Pestico run the shop and have become quite the draw for tourists and locals alike. However, recently one of these dolls has gone missing and, shortly after she disappeared, a string of bodies were found nearby. So far, the Korvosan Guard has kept these killings under wraps, as the victims were vagrants who have yet to be missed.⁠
1330431640:
Mount Rein

Mount Rein is a large, snow-topped mountain in the western end of the Fog Peaks, on the border between the nations of Galt and Taldor. It is used as a guide to the border between those two nations.⁠⁠⁠
1336952580:
Umnyango

Umnyango, known as Kalabuto during colonial times, is the largest settlement in Vidrian.⁠ It is a crumbling city built by Mwangi tribesmen in the pre-colonial era, and the overwhelming majority of the inhabitants are Mwangi who, until 4717 AR, were ruled over by a minority of Sargavan colonialists. It was the main target for the anti-colonial sentiments of the Mwangi city of Mzali to the east, and in time Mwangi both inside and outside of Umnyango united to expel the Sargavans from the city.⁠
1353376770:
Surat Prakan

Surat Prakan (pronounced sue-RA-ht pra-KHAN)⁠ is the traditional capital of Tang Mai, home of its ruling kamraten and their Cinnamon Throne, and is the Tian Xia nation's largest city.⁠
1354329170:
Ptirmeios

The Iblydan city of Ptirmeios is the capital city of the city-state of Pol-Ptirmeios on the island of Tos. By Iblydan standards, it is one of the smaller cities. Many kobolds live in Ptirmeios after their ancestors arrived here on a ship a thousand years ago.⁠
1362919490:
Misery Row

Misery Row is a street running along the eastern edge of the Coins district of Absalom, and was until recently was the only street in the city where the slave trade was always legal.⁠⁠ Slavery was abolished in Absalom following the events of the Fiendflesh Siege of 4717 AR.⁠
1370714480:
Learned Pig

The Learned Pig is one of the most popular taverns in the Wise Quarter. It doesn't follow the trend of affiliating with any single educational institution, preferring to remain neutral and welcoming students from all walks of life to sample its strong drinks. The exterior is decorated with flags and symbols of various district institutions. It's a roughly square building, and inside, the space is chaotic, with bookshelves overflowing everywhere and tables surrounding the central hall. People come from all walks of life to join in scientific collaborations and political or philosophical debates and when a debate is undecided, all eyes turn to the eponymous Learned Pig, who sits on a pen behind the tavern and awards the victory to whoever goes first when offered food. Upstairs, dignitaries can sleep in comfortable rooms, although unfortunately, the floorboards don't block out the noise from conversations below, making it difficult to get a good night's sleep.⁠
1373254640:
Union of Carpenters, Stonemasons, and Woodcutters

The Union of Carpenters, Stonemasons, and Woodcutters is located near the center of The Coins district, where the city's finest craftspeople gather and where commissions for projects requiring their talent are received.⁠
1377012830:
Citadel of the Alchemist

The fortress called the Citadel of the Alchemist is carved out of the base of a mountain in the Barrier Wall known as the Bent Razor in Thuvia. Above ground it appears as a modest stone structure. However, below ground there are vast tunnels housing alchemical traps and guardians. Hidden somewhere in this network are some of the best alchemical laboratories in the Inner Sea region.⁠ Artokus Kirran, creator of the sun orchid elixir, lives in the Citadel of the Alchemist, which was built for him many years ago.⁠

Every year a blind, mute servant comes forth from the citadel with six vials of the elixir, to be auctioned off in one of Thuvia's five city-states.⁠

The Stonewarden druids of the Barrier Wall mountains have a formal agreement with Thuvia to assist travelers that are seeking to reach the Citadel of the Alchemist.⁠
1397042830:
Pjallarane's Stone

Pjallarane's Stone is a rock formation in Irrisen's province of Thronehold. According to legend, Baba Yaga turned her rebellious daughter Pjallarane to stone here—and the formation does bear a remarkable resemblance to a woman clinging to a tree and begging for mercy. However, most scholars believe Pjallarane departed Golarion with her mother, just like all the other former Queens of Irrisen.

The stone does seem to have some strange arcane power, however, although no one has ever been able to access it. Some believe the stone might hold the key to banishing Irrisen's eternal winter, although there is scant evidence for this.

The local snow goblins view the stone as a holy site, and occasionally bury offerings to Baba Yaga nearby.⁠
1397941580:
Nagaiyamatsu

Nagaiyamatsu (pronounced nah-gie-yah-mah-tsoo)⁠ is a port city of the tengu kingdom of Kwanlai.⁠ It is prosperous as the nation's only port due to its location straddling the Sanga River.⁠
1399190210:
Absalom Academy of Law

The Absalom Academy of Law is one of its most influential educational institutions outside the nation, attracting students from as far away as Tian Xia who travel there to learn the city's laws and how to manage a bureaucratic body as large as Absalom's.⁠
1416626020:
Ekbet

The ruined city of Ekbet in Osirion is known as Gralgor-Ot by its sphinx residents. The ancient ruins are protected by the timeless guardians called living monoliths. These magically enhanced sentinels, powered by the sphinxes, protect the ancient ruins.⁠
1420860630:
Chapel of the Argent Shield

The Chapel of the Argent Shield is an Iomedaean temple located on the road between Kenabres and Egede. The chapel's walls are marked by many shrines and tributes honoring the fallen Mendevian Crusaders, as well as art mapping the region's numerous battlefields.⁠
1432209870:
Lionsguard

The small town of Lionsguard is located on the western edge of the Southern range mountains of southeastern Taldor, south of the Jalrune River.⁠
1433975800:
Immaculate Path

The Immaculate Path is a bridge connecting the Everlasting Palace to the rest of Kerse. It is a structure filled with fountains and golden statues of prophets of the past. Its open-air state might suggest a lack of defense, but that would be a misconception, as many of the statues are actually guardians that awaken to defend the bridge if it is invaded.⁠

Bank of Abadar

The Bank of Abadar is not only devoted to the god Abadar but also serves the city of Korvosa as its main banking institution, providing a range of services including providing (supposedly) the strongest lock-boxes in all Varisia. Beneath the Bank of Abadar sits the Korvosan Mint, which creates all the currency used by the city. The temple is led by Archbanker Darb Tuttle who works heavily with the ministers of the nearby City Hall and Longacre Building to ensure the economic health and well-being of the city of Korvosa.⁠
1450761700:
Bailax

Bailax is the capital of the city-state Pol-Bailax of Iblydos.⁠
1455122350:
Petronax Estate

Petronax Estate is the Petronax family home, made up of three multi-story structures. Vayde Petronax, the family patriarch, rarely leaves this estate.⁠

Sea Wrack Chapel

1474091520:
Chelish Fleet Wreckage

The Chelish Fleet Wreckage lies dozens of miles off the coast of Vidrian, having been Cheliax's response in 4643 AR to Sargava's independence and an attempt to bring it back into the empire. The Free Captains pirates, who were under Sargava's control, attacked the fleet, sinking it at sea. A sedacthy tribe is using the wreckage as a base from which they attack coastal settlements.⁠
1475140230:
Sabkha

Sabkha is a shallow basin filled with gritty salt-laden sand. It is the primary source for the nagri salt that farmers use to make pesh. Farmers travel to Sabkha once a season to sift salt out of the dirt and carry sacks of it home. Merchants flock to Sabkha to collect nagri salt, which they then sell in the markets of Katapesh. Once a month or so, heavy rains fill Sabkha's shallow basin with trapped rainwater. After several days, the water drains out through the rock, leaving new salt deposits on the surface.⁠
1480645510:
Wirholt's Rictus

Wirholt's Rictus is a farm near the Mindspin Mountains primarily dedicated to cultivating crops that can be processed into medicine and drugs. The farm sells its products to the Nidalese, though some foreign clients seeking to experience drug-induced pain also place orders. The owner is Temarra, a devoted follower of Zon-Kuthon, who punishes her employees to keep them docile.⁠

Beneath the farm are laboratories used by the Korholm Agenda to further their research.⁠
1480948140:
Abberton

Abberton is a small, declining town in the eastern part of the Isle of Erran. It is debated whether the town's name is shortened from Abadartown, or if it was named after the founding Abber family.⁠
1488794220:
Brimstone Haruspex

Though highly independent, even proud orc chieftains sometimes seek advice. When this happens, most warlords send their seconds-in-command to the Endseers of the Brimstone Haruspex, a temple complex high in the caldera of the smoking Eye of the Unmaker stratovolcano within the northern Kodar Mountains of the Hold of Belkzen.⁠
1492486880:
Orcmoot

The Orcmoot is the yearly meeting near the dromaar town of Averaka on the remote island of the Flintyreach in the Lands of the Linnorm Kings. At Orcmoot, the residents discuss their goals and visions for the island. Suota Iron-Tongue is the moderator of the Orcmoot.⁠
1512931650:
Greenblood

The Free Captains of the Shackles established a pit fight on a rock in the sea just off the coast of the Sodden Lands located northwest of Neruma⁠. It became known as Green Blood on a Black Rock, and its fame spread as far as Avistan.

The popularity of the event led to the settlement of Greenblood growing up close to the site. Its population of brigands are considered to be rough and lawless even by Shackles standards.⁠
1513369550:
Gap of Valballus

The Gap of Valballus is a wide, low mountain pass that connects the Hold of Belkzen to Ustalav to the east. It runs between the Tusk Mountains to the north and the Hungry Mountains to the south. Orc raiders traverse the Gap to sack the Ustalavic settlements in Canterwall. Varisian caravans and merchants also use the pass heading to or from Urgir.⁠
1524334070:
Dim Gate

The Dim Gate is an interplanetary gate deep beneath a peak in the Napsune Mountains of the eastern Sodden Lands. It is under construction by the lich diviner Meyi Panaho under the patronage of a mysterious being calling himself Tzriek, a bone sage from the dead planet Eox. Tzriek convinced Meyi to become immortal through lichdom in order to have the time to unlock the secrets of the universe.⁠⁠

A narrow trail winds up the mountain's peak to the Dim Gate complex's observatory, which overlooks a narrow, secluded valley. The mountains protect the observatory from the perpetually rotating arms of the Eye of Abendego that deluge the lowlands of the Sodden Lands, and the observatory's elevation provides a clear view of the sky on most nights. Skeletal champions patrol the grounds around the observatory,⁠⁠ and a nightwing called Gloomtide soars above the site keeping watch for intruders.⁠
1538260250:
Mount Dowama

The great Mount Dowama towers above the Screaming Jungle in the Mwangi Expanse. Its snowcapped summit is visible through every break in the tree cover and the jungle's natives revere it as a holy place. Foreigners, meanwhile, often see the mountain as a challenge to be climbed and reach the summit. These clashing viewpoints have led to cold diplomatic relations and other interactions between the two groups.⁠

It is located on the south-eastern side of the jungle and access to it is extremely difficult. Legends suggest that the ruins of the Shory Empire city of Ulduvai are hidden somewhere within an isolated vale.⁠
1542460470:
Steel Maridoth

The Steel Maridoth is the Possum Gang's base of operations in the Sodden Lands. Since the arrival of the Eye of Abendego, a multitude of ships have been adrift in the region, and these often gather and collide with each other, forming the Steel Maridoth, which gets its name from the large number of metal ships that congregate there.⁠
1549317020:
Billivin's Benevolent Balms and Effulgent Elixirs

Billivin's Benevolent Balms and Effulgent Elixirs is a curious shop run by the eccentric Billiver Billivin, and is located in the southwest of the Ordellia district in the Varisian city of Magnimar. A magic shop of sorts, Billivin's is overflowing with every sort of potion, elixir, scroll, alchemical supply, ingredient, book, papyrus, piece of sculpture, spell component, and other bric-a-brac imaginable, due to the fact that its gnomish owner is a compulsive collector (some would say hoarder) whose organizational skills leave something to be desired.⁠
1555116910:
Tokanos

Across Thieron, the legacy of its minotaur builders endures in their stone monuments, which draw pilgrims and travelers from across Casmaron. Foremost among Thieron’s wonders is the cliffside complex of Tokanos. Here dwells Ilegia, an immortal medusa oracle whose prophecies draw a steady procession of blindfolded supplicants; nobles, merchants, priests, and powerbrokers alike. Her words carry undeniable weight, shaping decisions far beyond the temple’s windswept ledges. Some come seeking truth. Others come seeking advantage. But it is said those who attempt to sway her through flattery or bribery leave a more permanent offering. The halls of Tokanos are lined with statues; silent, lifelike reminders of those who believed prophecy could be bought, and discovered too late the cost of such presumption.⁠
1556286070:
Starfall

Starfall is a city just as brutal and as harsh as the unforgiving Numerian land that it is capital of. The place is a mockery of the soft capitals of the south, with a level of decadence that would even put Taldor to shame. This decadence is surrounded by the filthy reek of human misery. Here the Black Sovereign, currently Kevoth-Kul, rules utterly unchallenged, his every whim catered to, while the rest of city suffers under his harsh rule. Until recently the only people who benefitted were those who help the court of the Black Sovereign indulge in his carnal decadence.⁠
1556857840:
Seraph's Ladder

Seraph's Ladder is a freestanding golden and white marble ladder that stands on the Blood Plains of the Hold of Belkzen.⁠ It is believed that Seraph's Ladder is one of the few remnants of the Thassilonian domain of Gastash, dating from the reign of Zutha, Runelord of Gluttony.⁠
1557523200:
Leydis

Leydis is a moss-covered ruined city located in the wood north of Rookwarden in the River Kingdoms region known as Loric Fells. It was founded by a Taldan prospector who struck pay dirt nearby, but was abandoned soon after it was founded. Its marble buildings and water-stained mosaics, not to mention the wealth in the abandoned nearby mine, still attract creatures and adventurers, but no one has been able to claim it for more than a year. Those who enter the ruins often find the skeletons of their predecessors hanging from its walls. Leydis is currently held by the medusa Chryphaena and her blind zombies.⁠
1564608820:
Walking Man

The Walking Man is a 30-foot-tall⁠ tree-like construct sculpted to resemble a human man. It consists of at least four different trees bound together with ivy and other vines and covered in herbs and flowers.⁠ The flowers include amaranth, bluebell, buttercup, celandine, clover, creeping bellflower, daffodil, dragon's teeth, eyebright, goldenrod, hawksbeard, hyacinth, iris, knotweed, lily, mouse-ear, mudwort, nightshade, orchid, shepherd's purse, and tansy.⁠ It was most likely created by elves, but no one remembers when or how it was made.⁠

Many have climbed inside of the construct's hulking body through an entrance in its shoulder and written notes.⁠ One such note, from Variel Morgethai, states that the burial mound Erithiel's Hall may somehow be connected to The Walking Man.⁠ In this room are panels that can act as controls for the construct, which were tested by Varian Jeggare.⁠ On midsummer each year, it takes one step towards Erages.⁠

The druids have tried to communicate with the Walking Man to ask for its help to fight the Whispering Tyrant but the voice from within the construct was unintelligible. The elves have asked the druid's Wildwood Lodge of the Verduran Forest for assistance in making their pleas heard by the ancient being.⁠
1568219260:
Xin-Edasseril

Xin-Edasseril was the capital of the ancient Thassilonian realm of envy, Edasseril.⁠ It is now the capital of the kingdom of Edasseril within the nation of New Thassilon.⁠
1578082990:
Seal of Kazutal

The Seal of Kazutal is a simple stone monument that serves as a shrine to the goddess in Absalom. Created by visitors from Arcadia while passing through, the monument has become a rallying point for freed slaves who are inspired by Kazutal's anti-slavery stance. Although the visitors from Arcadia are no longer there, the shrine is cared for by those who love freedom and their community.⁠
1580717200:
Cloudreaver Keep

An immense fortress called Cloudreaver Keep guards the eastern border of the Grand Duchy of Alkenstar. It is one of the three points connected by the massive Bridge of the Gods, the other two being Alkenstar City and Dongun Hold on the far side of the canyon. While the keep was intended to serve as a defense against outside threats, since its construction it has been plagued almost constantly with hauntings from ghosts within and attacks from nearby bands of yetis.⁠

The keep stands on the western bank of the Ustradi River, and all trade from Nex passes through it.⁠
1586855880:
Driftwood

Driftwood is a small town in the coast of Katapesh sheltered from the weather but with little trade thanks to its ragged terrain.⁠
1590567150:
Bosorka

The small town of Bosorka is located on the Frozen Road River, in the southeast corner of Irrisen's Feyfrost province. As with many towns along the Frozen Road River its main purpose is to assist those conveying goods and traveling down the river. It is located within sight of the border with the Realm of the Mammoth Lords, and therefore of a land not eternally dominated by the ravages of winter. No non-Jadwiga are allowed to cross the border out of Irrisen and the Jadwiga guards of Bosorka have to be ever vigilant with the border so plainly visible and enticing.⁠
1595224030:
Silver Suppers

Silver Suppers is a fish market, restaurant, and salmon-themed gift shop located in the Yolubilis Harbor district of Kintargo, Ravounel. As of 4724 AR its proprietor was salmon magnate and philanthropist Tevandis Sastrien.⁠
1623101120:
Old Sehir

Old Sehir is a small town in western Taldor, approximately 90 miles northwest of the capital city of Oppara.⁠
1633243520:
Pride of Azir

The Pride of Azir is an efficient shipyard in Absalom, focusing on creating dhows and with Rahadoum's considerable influence on its affairs.⁠

Azure Star

1639632460:
Kenabres

Kenabres is a city that borders the Sarkoris Scar, formerly known as the Worldwound. Its near-destruction in 4713 AR during a demonic assault was the inciting event of the Fifth Mendevian Crusade that eventually resulted in the Worldwound's closure.
1645675770:
Wartle

Though it is not a new settlement, the town of Wartle remains something of a frontier trading post, primarily populated by swampers and trappers who do not mind the inhospitable environment amidst the Mushfens. The buildings of the town rise out of the murky swamp water on stilts, connected by wooden boardwalks.⁠ Major exports of the town are peat, fungus, and furs, mostly sent down the Yondabakari River to Magnimar. The town sports a few successful brothels and a precariously tilted tavern called the Lean-To, which serves a local liquor called Bog Grog.⁠
1647159190:
Crystal Falls

The Crystal Falls is a 100-foot-tall waterfall in western Andoran, located in the southern Aspodell Mountains near the border with Cheliax. The beautiful site has the reputation of being haunted and is generally avoided by the local populace.⁠

A secret Chelaxian base lies hidden inside one of the caves and the spies will silence any who learn of its existence.⁠
1650823490:
Fort Kragang

Fort Kragang is an occupied fort among the mountain realms of Zi Ha, originally constructed by invading hobgoblins from Kaoling under the leadership of Warlord Tsung-cha Kavangaki. It is currently occupied by a contingent of troops led by Ping-la Maningki, which harass local samsarans, raiding them for supplies and capturing them.⁠ Some samsarans of Zi Ha have hired mercenaries to oppose the hobgoblins, so it may only be a matter of time before a clash erupts.⁠
1665471310:
Red Pyramid

2 locations:

1677250920:
Yan Tlomíl

Yan Tlomíl is the largest agricultural centre in Xopatl since the fall of Chídanza. The land surrounding it yields an incredible bumper crop each year, but no one knows which crop will benefit, so each farmer plants multiple crops each year and waits to see which will flourish. When one of the plants starts thriving beyond all the others, it sparks a mad rush of farmers scrabbling to secure more seeds and land to grow more of this bumper crop. Due to this element of chance and the chaotic competition to capitalise on the flourishing crop, Yan Tlomíl's agricultural influence has yet to equal Chídanza's.⁠
1678238880:
Grand Bazaar

Nearly anything can be found for sale in the Grand Bazaar of The Coins district in Absalom. The area has few permanent buildings, and most goods are sold from tents, carts, portable stages, and merchant wagons. Many merchants use dancers or illusionists to draw a sufficient crowd to make a sale. After dark, the Grand Bazaar becomes quite dangerous as criminals from the Docks and Puddles districts come here in search of heavy purses.⁠⁠
1682486830:
Acisazi

Acisazi is a small aquatic elven shoreline village in Ravounel, north of the Ravounel Forest. It was a part of Cheliax until 4717 AR, when the Archduchy of Ravounel seceded and became an independent nation.⁠
1688705920:
Foxglove Manor

Foxglove Manor is a haunted mansion on the western coast of Varisia (also known as the Lost Coast), approximately halfway between Magnimar and Sandpoint. Constructed in 4624 AR by minor Magnimarian noble Vorel Foxglove, and funded by the Brotherhood of the Seven, Foxglove Manor was intended to be the ancestral home of Foxglove's family for 100 years before reverting to the Brotherhood's ownership. Three generations of Foxgloves have met tragic ends in the Manor, from Vorel and his wife to Aldern Foxglove, who perished in 4707 AR. The manor consists of three stories overlooking a high sea cliff, a basement and natural cave network, and a ruined outbuilding.⁠

As of 4710 AR, Foxglove Manor is believed to still be haunted by Vorel's malign spirit and is currently uninhabited.⁠
1693069150:
Ohira

Ohira is the Spirit Road's largest village and serves as a popular intermediate destination for adventurers seeking to journey deeper into the Forest of Spirits.⁠
1710505850:
Gholinom

Gholinom is a secret alghollthu factory-city hidden in an oceanic trench west of Rahadoum.⁠
1718928130:
Meravon

Meravon, sometimes spelled Merovan,⁠⁠ is a logging settlement located within the Immenwood on the Isle of Kortos. It is considered the center of Absalom's lumber industry, and the wood cut in the forest is transported either by the Deluge River to Diobel or overland to Otari.⁠⁠⁠
1721322280:
Greengold

The port city of Greengold is the second-largest settlement in Kyonin⁠⁠ and the first in the elven kingdom to admit non-elves.⁠ Situated on Lake Encarthan, Greengold is a popular port of call for traders and diplomats. Greengold generally resembles any other human dockside settlement, except for the trees that grow in unexpected parts of the city and its distinct yellow roofs.⁠⁠

1741748040:
Mohgan

Mohgan, also called the City of the Lakes, was a settlement in the kingdom of Gastash, north of its capital. The city was chosen by Zutha to investigate a qlippoth runestone associated with Oaur-Ooung, which he had discovered in the Astral Plane.⁠

Zutha planned to use the powerful stone to create an artifact that would grant infinite necromantic energy, but when his apprentices awakened the runestone's power, a wave of black liquid began to emerge from it. Zutha and his assistants created an anti-magic containment field capable of holding back the flood for some time, and before they could develop a long-term plan to solve the problem, Earthfall destroyed his kingdom. Since then, the city has been forgotten, but little by little, the barriers blocking the water are eroding, and the surrounding region, called the Keening Hills, is teeming with life, with lakes and creatures of all kinds. For their part, the orcs avoid the area completely.⁠
1743528850:
Prophet's Home

The city of Prophet's Home is located in the northeast of the country of Druma. It is best known for housing the training facilities of the Mercenary League, the military protection and enforcement arm of the Prophets of Kalistrade.⁠
1745620540:
Stavian Ranches

The Stavian Ranches are home to the finest horses in all of Taldor, for they are the horses ridden by the royal lineage. Founded by Stavian I, the stables breed Taldan horses used by the cavalry, although breeding Qadiran horses is forbidden by royal decree. Stavian III's horse, Dycephalus, traces his lineage back to the horse ridden by his great-grandfather, Kaillerophon.⁠
1757158190:
Barbarous Arena

The Barbarous Arena is located in the underground of the Pilgrimage District, hosting fights every week between recruits from the city and creatures brought in from abroad. Although no one knows the owner's identity, the consistency of the fights and their ability to operate outside the Mercenary League's watchful eye suggest they are someone powerful indeed. One reason why little is known about the arena is that most of its workers suffer from induced amnesia and have no memory of working that day.⁠
1773236070:
Verity Inquiries

Verity Inquiries is a detective agency run by Pal Kusdy whose cases focus primarily on citizen complaints against the government or the Kalistocrats, as there aren't many crimes to investigate in Kerse itself. He is investigating potential cases of corruption within this order, which he considers a false philosophy that must be exposed for what it is.⁠
1788175850:
Grand Grounds of the Splendid Statuary

The Grand Grounds of the Splendid Statuary is a market and showcase of statuary near Rhuzam, Druma, that is owned and operated by the dwarven Prophet Jurgan Khrest. Khrest has long employed the finest sculptors from across the Inner Sea region to craft the mundane and magical works he displays on the grounds, though his expenses have begun to overtake his profits and he has begun resorting to using his sold statues to scry secrets from his fellow prophets.⁠
1789985930:
Devil's Drain

Devil's Drain is a dangerous whirlpool in the Steaming Sea located between the coasts of Southmoor and the Ironbound Island of Dragon's Rib.⁠ On a good day there is just enough room either side of the Devil's Drain for a ship to pass through, though it is always treacherous. Using this route saves enough time on the passage to Varisia that desperate captains will still sometimes risk it.⁠

Devil's Drain appears to be a natural occurrence formed by oceanic currents but adventurers who have returned from its depths report mysterious deep rifts in the ocean floor below it. To make matters worse, the area surrounding Devil's Drain has at times been home to dragon turtles, fjord linnorms, scyllas, and krakens who often drive ships into the whirlpool to feast on the shipwrecked sailors.⁠
1792497670:
Dimcrater

Dimcrater is a mysterious crater located in the southernmost tip of Kyonin's Fierani Forest, well within the Tanglebriar, the domain of the nascent demon lord Treerazer.⁠⁠ It was once known as Arabrecht, the manor home of the timeless and powerful Archmage Aelthian, prior to its disappearance during Aelthian's attempt to banish Treerazer in 2988 AR.⁠⁠⁠
1810625760:
Deromas

Little is known about Deromas, a settlement of western Osirion during its First Age located in what is now Rahadoum.⁠⁠ The city was known for its lawful nature⁠ and situated on the southern banks of the Uta River.⁠
1810845130:
Saintsgrove

Saintsgrove is a small area of ancient olive trees in the south-east of the county of Sinaria, in Ustalav, lying near the southern banks of Lake Prophyria, and to the south-east of Karcau.⁠

Legends speak of a priestess of Urgathoa who performed a sacrilegious ceremony to transform herself into a Daughter of Urgathoa at this spot, perverting a shrine of Desna and sacrificing the followers of the Song of the Spheres as part of her ritual. Such blasphemy apparently stirred Desna to direct action against the priestess by immediately ageing the olive trees by a thousand years, trapping the blasphemer and preventing her ritual from succeeding, while providing a grave for her dead worshippers.⁠
1813759690:
Blackfingers Temple

Blackfingers Temple is the primary place of worship to Norgorber in the city of Absalom and is the only known place of worship that exclusively reveres Norgorber's Blackfingers aspect. Although the clergy maintains a façade of legitimacy it is an open secret that the clergy secretly engage in torture and poison brewing in the temple's lower levels.⁠
1827391350:
Sunset Imports

Sunset Imports is a harborfront import house in Kintargo that was among the city's wealthiest companies until losing its contracts with House Thrune in 4715 AR.⁠⁠ Its fortunes have improved as of 4724 AR due to its role in fostering trade with the distant continent of Arcadia.⁠
1834551020:
Thesing's Tower

Thesing's Tower was the residence of Thesing Umbero Ulvauno, the popular but arrogant actor of Westcrown, who, after his death, rose as a vampire seeking revenge against the actors who stole his thunder in his last performance. The stone tower served as a guard post in the past and is in good condition, standing up to 30 feet tall.⁠
1837184010:
Neruma

Unusually for the Shackles, the city of Neruma is not on the coast. It is one of the few major settlements on the mainland, and is situated in the northeast along the Terwa River close to the borders with the Mwangi Expanse and the Sodden Lands. Neruma is a centre for trade between the Shackles and those two neighbouring regions.⁠ The main trading items purchased here are slaves, but other items of value also occasionally make their way along the river to Neruma.

The city's current ruler is Cousotta Shald. She is assisted by the Steel Cordage, a group of mercenaries supplied by the Shackles' ruling Pirate Council.

The city is built on lizardfolk breeding grounds (although the townsfolk are unaware of this), and is subject to regular attacks by lizardfolk seeking to reclaim their lost territory.⁠
1842261290:
Floater's Pond

Located near the vast salt flats of the Sabkha in central Katapesh, Floater's Pond is an oasis unlike any other, as it is a salt water oasis. The water seeps through the ground into the salt-laden sand, but thanks to the constant seeping water it never dries out. The water instead becomes inundated with salt.

Floater's Pond is so salty that it is almost impossible to sink in it, but that also means the pond is completely uninhabitable to aquatic plants or animals. Sometimes desperate pesh farmers come to Floater's Pond to harvest valuable nagri salt, but the process is time consuming because the farmer has to soak a sheet in the salty water and wait until it dries and leaves behind the valuable salt.⁠
1848691730:
Cascina

The tiny hamlet of Cascina is a sleepy little settlement located in Meratt County in the Tandak Prefecture south of the Verduran Forest and east of Cassomir. Cascina consists of only a few extended families who once worked for the Voinum barony most of whom now live as simple farmers of goats, sheep, or wheat. The hamlet's most notable resident is Yarelle Towsine, a minor wizard who offers her spells to help the local community. As part of Meratt County, Cascina is subjected to the harsh rule of House Lotheed.⁠

1865058900:
Soth-Silir

Soth-Silir is a 30-foot-tall, oddly shaped monument on the northern edge of the Ombrefell, guarded by the Xoskerik tribe of shadow giants led by their priest Salifeth. Several shelters serve as homes for the shadow giants, who patrol the Atteran Ranches, inspiring both respect and fear. The sacrifice of Nidalese heretics is common at the monument and their provision forms part of the Xoskerik's agreement with the Umbral Court. Not all heretics are suitable for sacrifice: some are eaten instead; those deemed unfit are exiled to Varisia through the Uthori Pass.⁠
1866944480:
Crooked Falls

The Crooked Falls are a series of five waterfalls, each dropping by 10 to 30 feet, over a one-mile course in the northern Stolen Lands section of the Shrike River. Its challenging features prevent river trade between Brevoy and lands to the south, with most trade traditionally using the East Sellen River through Hooktongue Slough instead. The Crooked River flows into the Shrike around half-way through this cascade of waterfalls.⁠
1870860550:
Oleg's Trading Post

Located about a dozen miles north of the Narlmarches on the southern edge of Brevoy, Oleg's Trading Post is an old border fort rebuilt to function as a trading post by Oleg Leveton and his wife Svetlana Leveton.⁠ The repurposed fort has seen mild financial success through hard work, visits from travelling merchants and a loan from Restov.⁠ However, the trading post is too remote and distant from any major waterways to reach its full potential—mainly relying on hunters, trappers, and a hermit named Bokken as their clientele.⁠

Lately, the Stag Lord's bandits have taken notice of the trading post and regularly plunder its pitiful earnings. If not for his wife, the prideful owner would have already died fighting the bandits, but for her sake, he has requested reinforcements from Restov instead.⁠
1871971760:
Bail House

The Bail House is the headquarters of the Token Guard, the district watch of the Coins district of Absalom.⁠ It gets its name from the guards' habit of jailing everyone present at a disturbance and holding them until they can post bail, which is usually 1 copper piece per arrest. The edifice is a squat building of wood and mortar with barred windows and two gated entrances, designed primarily to survive a riot.⁠

Jawafeeq

Jolizpan

Jolizpan is a city located in the extreme northwest of Xopatl, near Tumbaja Mountain, the nexus of Xopatl's Veins of Creation.⁠

1897006750:
Karakuru

Karakuru is a small city located on the banks of Taldor's Porthmos River, just on the southern edge of the foothills of the southern World's Edge Mountains.⁠⁠ Known as the City of a Hundred Fountains, Karakuru sits atop a high-pressure natural spring that brings water up to the surface.⁠ The citizens of Karakuru have harnessed this water source to power both the fountains that give the town its nickname as well as bathhouses that draw tourists of every class from throughout Taldor. Due to this constant influx of noble visitors arriving to soak in the ochre-colored mineral water in the hopes of alleviating aches and pains and treat chronic illnesses, the small tourist city is one of the wealthiest communities in Porthmos.⁠

Karakuru is also home to Taldor's iconic fighting style known as rondelero, which represents a combination of peasant dances and noble weapons, a mixture that is a direct consequence of the interactions between people of all classes that happens at the bathhouses.⁠ The lightly armored fighting style uses an off-hand buckler to deflect blows and distract the opponent, while delivering precise strikes with a falcata. A small academy specializing in this combat art, known as the Rondelero School, is located in Karakuru and accepts up to a hundred students at any given time. Students typically come from a talent pool that includes locals, sons of the nation's wealthier families, and the most promising military officers in the empire. Though it is possible to learn rondelero at other combat schools that operate without the same exclusivity or punishing footwork drills, no institution has produced more skilled or respected masters of the fighting style.⁠
1901377680:
Urgir

Urgir is the unofficial capital of the orc-ruled Hold of Belkzen. The nation has no true capital as Belkzen has no centralized government, yet the ruler of Urgir is generally seen by most orcs as the most powerful chieftain in the area. The disparate tribes of Belkzen are fiercely independent and fight against each other even more than they fight outsiders. Urgir's leader as of 4724 AR, the intelligent Ardax the White-Hair, has instituted changes in the hopes of encouraging cooperation and greater unity.⁠⁠
1920027940:
Ortalaca

Ortalaca is a small town in the southwestern-most foothills of Taldor's Southern Range of the World's Edge Mountains, located near the intersection of the Ligos, Lingian, Sophra, and Whitemarch Prefectures.⁠⁠
1926650470:
Vurnirn

Vurnirn is a centaur settlement situated in the north-east of the Hoofwood, in the region of Iobaria known as the Dvezda Marches. It acts a meeting place for the various centaur tribes.⁠ It was founded in 1466 AR.
1930475610:
Shrine of Convocations

The Shrine of Convocations serves as the meeting place for the Umbral Court, where they resolve disputes, receive reports, and determine policy for the coming months. This convocation takes place during the fall and spring, where members debate and decide on the best resolutions, which are then decided democratically. The Black Triune only intervenes in emergency situations, where its orders are unquestionable and absolute.⁠

If a member of the Umbral Court fails to attend the convocation, they are punished with death, and on occasion, various rivals have caused their opponents to be absent from the event to eliminate them.⁠
1938780960:
Brastlewark

Brastlewark is an almost exclusively gnomish city in eastern Cheliax, located on the western edge of the Aspodell Mountains,⁠ at the head of the Brastle River.⁠ It is believed to be the largest gnome settlement in the Inner Sea region, perhaps even in the entire world.
1940246940:
Jovvox

Jovvox is a largely gnomish town east of the city of Mivon. Originally built around a remote monastery by the enterprising gnome merchant Jov, Jovvox's weaponsmiths specialize in producing large quantities of cheap weapons, fast, thereby undercutting competition. Their raw materials come from a small nearby iron mine and from halfling and human scouts who also make Jovvox home and scavenge battlefields throughout the region for cast-offs that could be recycled. Kellywells, the current leader of the town, is known for crafting exotic, novel weapons.⁠
1944354790:
Barracuda Cartage

The Barracuda Cartage is a three-story office complex with a space to park carriages that the Aspis Consortium purchased and renovated to be their new base of operations in Riddleport. It is managed by Vidrin Jenk, the city's silver agent.⁠
1945819540:
Weeping Stairwell

The Weeping Stairwell is a hidden series of caverns on the eastern coast that provide access to the isolated upper reaches of the secret island of Grand Sarret.⁠

The Weeping Stairwell can be accessed from the waters of the Obari Ocean via a cave that lies concealed below the waterline along the eastern reaches of Grand Sarret. The Weeping Stairwell can also be accessed from the island's top via a narrow fissure hidden within the dense foliage of Grand Sarret. The Weeping Caverns gained their name as a small stream cascades down the through the caverns making the climb up from the ocean even more treacherous. To make matters worse for any trying to traverse the Weeping Stairwell, the masters of the Conservatory, the Jalmeri training school for spies that sits atop Grand Sarret, are well aware of the Stairwell's existence. As such they have placed a pair of faydhaan to guard the Weeping Stairwell to prevent intruders from accessing the island.⁠
1961801730:
Crimson Coin

Crimson Coin is a bustling two-story tavern and gambling house located in the Foreign Quarter in the city of Absalom.⁠ It was one of the bars at which the Pathfinder Society was founded on 23 Desnus, 4307 AR.⁠

Fort Landing

Fort Landing is an ancient, ruined stone fortress on the western coast of the Isle of Terror in Lake Encarthan. The fort has crumbled over the centuries and is now little more than a series of interconnected walls that surround a partially collapsed tower covered in arm-thick ivy. The true name of the fort has been lost to time, and its current one stems from the fact that the white sand beaches near the ruin are the easiest place to land when approaching the island from the west. The ceaselessly blowing wind blows against the fort's western wall, sometimes forming sand drifts as high as 30 feet.⁠ The nightwing Jolanera actively avoids Fort Landing as part of an agreement made with the Whispering Tyrant.⁠
1979779210:
Castle of the Captive Sun

The Castle of the Captive Sun in Nidal is home to the vampiric nobleman Volsazni Dezarr. The castle is primarily known for housing a very large collection of holy artifacts.⁠
1988814460:
Crimson Wood Furs

Crimson Wood Furs is a high-quality clothing store in the west of the Isgeri town of Breachill from which many Hellknights have purchased in the past, a fact depicted in paintings displayed by the store. The owner, Winthrop Finney, worked here for years before buying the shop.⁠ With a deep love for adventure, Finney often offers discounts to adventurers if they recommend or speak highly of the clothes they purchase from him.⁠
2040326470:
City Hall

The City Hall of Korvosa was built before the rise of the Korvosan monarchy and House Thrune in distant Cheliax, making it one of the city's most prominent buildings built in the pre-diabolic style, known as the New White architectural style. The building's facade is characterised by large pillars, rectangular windows, and a whitewashed exterior. Despite the rise of the monarchy, the City Hall is still a busy building, housing much of the city's bureaucracy. The most famous inhabitant of City Hall is not a person but a painting. Breaking the Siege is a massive eight-by-thirteen-foot painting depicting Field Marshal Korvosa meeting Sergeant Endrin atop the earthworks of Fort Korvosa, painted by the artist Endrik Archerus. While the painting is without a doubt the most famous piece of art in or about Korvosa, it also contains many historical inaccuracies.⁠
2046496720:
Lamond's Lament

Lamond's Lament is a place dedicated to helping those most in need, located in the north of the Isgeri town of Breachill. The establishment offers food and overnight accommodations to anyone who wants them, and it is all funded through donations and public initiatives. Renatta Gilroy manages the place, assisted by volunteers. Greta Gardania helped at Lamond's Lament before joining the Breachill Town Council.⁠
2050399240:
Old Megus's Shack

Old Megus's Shack is what one's expect from a witch's swamp house, though Old Megus isn't as sinister as the rumors might suggest. She doesn't socialize with anyone, so the shack rarely receives visitors and she spends her time reading.⁠
2055750150:
White Grotto

White Grotto is the premier bardic college in Absalom where the students learn the art of using magic to enhance all forms of entertainment.⁠⁠ The school is located in the upscale Ivy District.⁠

The college is not associated with any guilds, but pays the Ivy District Council and the district's larger businesses and establishments to allow their students to perform without worrying about repercussions. Students wear uniforms that reflect their rank—green for apprentices, blue for journeymen, and black for masters. Graduates can no longer enjoy the school's support, and have to figure out how they will earn a living themselves.⁠
2059921180:
Erekrus

Erekrus is a subterranean necropolis in southern Osirion, west of Mount Osiki. It is built on the side of the mountain and serves as a necropolis for pharaohs who were noble and worthy for Pahmet's blessings. In Ancient Osirion it was a great honor to be blessed by the Pahmet.⁠⁠⁠

Two of the pharaohs who earned the blessings of the Pahmet of Erekrus were Osezis II and Menedes XVII. Osezis II became famous for his policies which ended a nationwide famine. He was entombed in Erekrus in -652 AR. Menedes XVII earned Pahmet's favor because he managed to abolish the slavery system during his reign. He was entombed in Erekrus in 1262 AR.⁠⁠

Erekrus is ruled by a pair of priests who claim to be siblings, Garzukk and Trelka. Together they guide the Pahmet in their prayers and rituals to honor the deceased god-kings of Osirion. They have disparate features for siblings as Garzukk who is the older of the two, has long golden locks of hair and bronze skin while Trelka is dour with dusky skin.⁠⁠
2060668030:
Free Union Headquarters

The Free Union Headquarters is located in The Coins, a beautiful three-story building created by the freed slaves who make up the organization. Milly Tundall, the organization's director, has her office inside, although she is rarely at her desk, preferring to go outside.⁠
2065924720:
Wreck of the Nightvoice

The Nightvoice was a ship of exploration in the employ of the Pathfinder Society, with a home port of Almas, Andoran. The ship went missing while returning from a voyage to the coast of southern Garund decades prior to 4710 AR. Its true fate was unknown to most: it had crashed between a pair of rocks off the shore of Silent Island, a small island off the coast of Smuggler's Shiv in Desperation Bay, decades prior to 4710 AR.⁠
2070871200:
Gozarin Necropolis

The Gozarin Necropolis is a vast field of tombs, crypts, and graveyards within the Tremor Valley in central Osirion, west of the Pillars of the Sun.⁠
2071267340:
Eyes of the Hawk

Eyes of the Hawk is a monument in the Dockway district of Magnimar. It depicts the Eyes of the Hawk adventuring party and its twin wizards Cailyn and Romre Vanderale defeating the spider-like shriezyx in 4623 AR. Local lore suggests mediating here grants a mystical advantage when injuring aberrant creatures.⁠

Administrative and Civic Center of Ravounel

The Administrative and Civic Center of Ravounel, colloquially called the People's Temple and formerly known as the Temple of Asmodeus and Temple of Aroden, is the largest temple in Kintargo and government capitol of Ravounel. It dominates the Temple Hill district.⁠⁠
2093752980:
Scriveners' Square

Scriveners' Square is where the offices of most of the city's newspapers are located, publishing articles on politics, fashion, and entertainment for all who buy them. The fountain in the center of the square resembles an inkwell, and one can hear kids shouting about the latest local news, advertising their particular paper, the sound of the printing presses—dozens of them running at once—overpowering their voices.⁠
2096927900:
Dorjanala

Dorjanala is a palace built in 4336 AR by order of Queen Dorjana to serve as her magnificent city residence, featuring solariums with crystals constructed from metal plates on the sides. In 4716 AR, a descendant of the monarch, the knight Bellinia Dorjana, took possession of the site for the Glorious Reclamation.⁠

2116781610:
Kintargo

Kintargo, also known as the Silver City, is the capital of Ravounel and is situated on Nisroch Bay at the mouth of the Yolubilis River.⁠ It is the main harbor for ships heading north to Varisia and west to Anchor's End.
2117115270:
Hallein Town

Hallein Town is a small Lastwall settlement located on the Path River downstream of Vigil.⁠ Situated at the foot of a high tarn rising from the shores of Lake Hallensee, access to it by land is almost impossible. Hallein Town is the home of the workers for the salt mines in the Virlych hills of nearby Ustalav, and provides vital trade goods for the rest of the nation.⁠
2131433870:
Ahnkamen Estate

The Ahnkamen Estate is a beautiful Osirian-style manor with magnificent gardens that are frequently visited for the parties held every two weeks. These are the most fun in town, and no one realizes that beneath them lie cellars with temples to Yog-Sothoth and other Outer Gods, the extensive residence of Mother Jackal, who uses illusions and abjurations to maintain the secrecy of her existence. The Eaters of Knowledge also operate in the area, taking bodies from the city's prisons and serving them to their mistress. Only the most influential in House Ahnkamen, such as Scion Lady Neferpatra, know of their progenitor's existence, and it is their knowledge, which predates the existence of Ancient Osirion, that allowed them to rise to masters in matters of law and death.⁠
2133103380:
Kharif

Kharif is a Qadiran city located in the Northern Zho Mountains area, nestled in the foothills between two different spurs of the Zho Mountains. It is on the northern bank of the River Ladan, which separates the Northern Zho Mountains region from Qadira's Pashman region.⁠ The Northern Zho Mountains are the poorest region in Qadira and faces the neighbouring land of Taldor across the Jalrune River. As such, it is the least hungry for war with their northern neighbors.⁠
2140042350:
Imperial Marina

The Imperial Marina was established in 4634 AR in the easternmost part of Westcrown's mainland to gain naval superiority over river trade. In 4716 AR, it was used by the Glorious Reclamation as a prison for the nobility who opposed their rule.⁠⁠
2140119930:
Wormwood Hall

Wormwood Hall is located deep within the Lurkwood of north-western Varisia, near the forest's border with the Red Mountains.⁠ A large manor house overrun by chocking vines, no being has set foot within the hall in living memory. Strange, twisting runes cover its doors and walls, and it is generally assumed that Wormwood is tied to the Lurkwood's strange seasons.⁠⁠
2140465540:
Ker Sharic

Ker Sharic is a secluded settlement located on the shores of the Lake of Mists and Veils in Iobaria. Despite the outward appearance of simplicity and plainness among its residents, Ker Sharic is known for its exceptional craftsmanship and artistry, which can rival even the most masterful artisans in grand cities like New Stetven and Oppara.⁠

The village's artisans produce exquisite goods, including flawless window glass, delicate gossamer damask tapestries, and finely glazed stoneware. These exceptional works of art have garnered local fame and a high demand among collectors.⁠

However, the residents of Ker Sharic are a very insular people. The villagers lead a meager and modest lifestyle and tend to remain within the confines of their community. They seldom venture beyond their village's fenced borders.⁠

One of the key mysteries surrounding Ker Sharic is the village's enigmatic trade partners. Every month, cloaked visitors bearing a mysterious white-and-blue banner arrive in the village. These visitors purchase the village's exquisite crafts, offering unmarked gold coins in return. The income from these transactions serves as Ker Sharic's lifeblood, but the people remain in the dark about the origin and intentions of these visitors. The people are always anxious that one day these mysterious patrons might cease their monthly visits, which could disrupt the village's fragile yet steady source of income.⁠
2141182670:
Eodred's Square

Eodred's Square forms a large plaza at the western end of the High Bridge in the Varisian city of Korvosa. Eodred's Square is popular with both locals and visitors to the city, and is a popular meeting place for both in the Midland district.⁠
